Live suite checkout tracked dirty -> SuiteLoader refuses GIT_STATUS/SYNC_PINNED
Existing stable Bootstrap independent suite resource checkout tracked dirty
Stable manifest mutates pinned tracked JS files via patch_auto_reply_loop_guard, so next bootstrap can detect dirty generated state

mvp.definition: One bounded authenticated command, SHA-pinned artifact/script, exactly-one ESP32-C3 USB chip, full preflash backup, verified flash offsets, immutable completion receipt read in the same ChatGPT turn

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Known CI firmware image and SHA-verified flasher
Read-only diagnostics enumerate tracked differences in BOTH checkouts without SuiteLoader
Non-destructive isolated worker deployment without resetting or cleaning dirty checkouts
New worker activated and ESP32_IR_FLASH explicitly accepted
USB ESP32-C3 identified uniquely, entire preflash image SHA-backed up
Flash succeeds + Web learning UI verified on device + structured GitHub receipt

immediate_blocker: Current live allowed actions cannot enumerate dirty paths because GIT_STATUS is downstream of SuiteLoader; old Bootstrap stable runner fails on a separate dirty resource before deploying worker.
safety_invariants: Never reset --hard, clean -fdx or overwrite tracked or untracked user files in recovery
Do not treat Bootstrap tracked-dirty as the same checkout as SuiteLoader tracked-dirty
Do not issue repeated flash calls or retry an indeterminate flash outcome
No arbitrary command execution, remote argv, firmware, path or port selection
No change to unrelated stable Chrome extension flow solely for IR flash
Flash must fail closed unless backup completed; keep original and new copies separately
GitHub logs are evidence, not substitute for physical success
next_safe_work: Use already committed checkout-inspect feature implementation or introduce an equivalent bounded read-only action independent of SuiteLoader; deployment method must not itself require a clean existing checkout
Use an isolated immutable worker checkout and verified scheduled handover preserving in-flight Issue acknowledgement
After a Mac PING proves new worker code active, send fresh one-time ESP32_IR_FLASH with no args
Read the unique SUITE_EC_RESULT_V3 receipt and associated GitHub JSON, and classify PASS/BLOCKED on observation only
notes: Desktop Commander device appurunoAir.elecom reported offline during current investigation; do not rely on that tool.
Previous remote BOOTSTRAP_RUN used stable manifest which mutates JS tracked files and may reload a Chrome tab; avoid rerun as read-only step.
No physical flash, backup, Wi-Fi UI or IR learning was observed in this turn.

rca_review.question: Are errors caused by proceeding without mapping which code/artifacts are stored where and which version Mac actually runs?

root_cause_hierarchy.title: Bootstrap tracked-file gate and source-tree mutation conflict
root_cause_hierarchy.implementation: SUITE-Bridge-Bootstrap/bootstrap/runner.py::resource checks git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no before use; stable-v1.json step patch_auto_reply_loop_guard writes four tracked files in the SAME pinned checkout
root_cause_hierarchy.proof: All four pinned source files contain required autoreply01 marker, and the primary JS also contains other asserted anchors. Workflow will leave tracked changes when patch step runs successfully; a later resource() on this checkout rejects tracked modifications. Whether THIS dirty incident originated exclusively from that step remains unproven.

root_cause_hierarchy.title: SuiteLoader blocks diagnostic before dirty paths are emitted
root_cause_hierarchy.implementation: GPT-Development-Suite/poc/native-local-bridge-v3/src/suite_loader.py::_load_suite_uncached checks git tracked status and raises SUITE_CHECKOUT_DIRTY without file inventory
root_cause_hierarchy.proof: Mac Issue GIT_STATUS and SYNC_PINNED fail at loader before returning working-tree paths

root_cause_hierarchy.title: Unverified deployment: source branch and active worker differ
root_cause_hierarchy.implementation: Action ESP32_IR_FLASH committed in GPT-Development-Suite/poc/native-local-bridge-v3 a90ddb1 but running Mac worker rejected it with ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED
root_cause_hierarchy.proof: Mac Issue response is authoritative rejection; last observed LaunchAgent runs detached live checkout and does not publish active worker version in PING

root_cause_hierarchy.title: Multi-checkout/multi-ref provenance not tracked in one current deployment inventory
root_cause_hierarchy.implementation: Separate live, bootstrap, autoreply-loopguard, firmware artifact, pinned flasher and Issue worker; no verified table of target HEAD, git status, hashes and launchctl argv before attempted deploy
root_cause_hierarchy.proof: Sources show separate paths and refs; no Mac runtime inventory for exact paths and commit after last deployment attempts; resulting attempts assume source commit implies active runtime.
